slices.name: coverage
slices.description: Rev5 baseline coverage per certification class, with orphan controls.
slices.ordering: `classes` ascending by class letter; `orphanControls` and family rows ascending by canonical id / family code.

slices.name: baseline
slices.description: Full Rev5 baseline enumeration per class: every control id with family, annual-assessment and KSI-coverage flags.
slices.ordering: `classes` ascending by class letter; `controls` ascending by canonical control id; `families` ascending.

slices.name: checks
slices.description: Per-KSI collector scaffold: statement, terms, controls, classes in scope and the class vulnerability-response clock.
slices.ordering: `checks` in dataset theme order, then indicator order within a theme; `controls` ascending by canonical id; `cadence` and `clocks` ascending by class letter.

slices.name: aws-evidence
slices.description: AUTHORED overlay: AWS calls that collect evidence per KSI/control, with cadence, GovCloud notes and an automatable-honesty rating. Versioned separately from the dataset.
slices.ordering: `recipes` in authored order — the overlay is a hand-maintained file and its sequence is editorial, not derived. Sort by `id` if you need a stable key.

slices.name: automation-frontier
slices.description: AUTHORED overlay: per-control dispositions for KSI-reached controls no AWS recipe covers — automatable, partial, or honestly closed as narrative, each with a stated reason. Versioned separately from the dataset.
slices.ordering: `queue` by `leverage` DESCENDING, ties broken on canonical control id; `frontier` ascending by canonical control id.

slices.name: evidence-plan
slices.description: The Evidence Plan: per class, authored AWS recipes grouped by KSI theme (densest first), the class clock, and the orphan/narrative register.
slices.ordering: `classes` ascending by class letter; `themes` by `controlFootprint` DESCENDING (densest first), ties broken on theme key; `items` in overlay order; `orphanControls` ascending by canonical id.

slices.name: obligations
slices.description: Every timeframed deadline, PAIN grid, notification and rollout date.
slices.ordering: `deadlines` TIGHTEST FIRST across incompatible units, ties broken on requirement id then class. The comparison is an internal hours-normalized key; the displayed `num`/`type` are always the dataset's own units and are never converted.

slices.name: evidence
slices.description: Every artifact the rules demand, by requirement and deduplicated by artifact.
slices.ordering: `byRequirement` ascending by requirement id; `byArtifact` by number of demanding requirements DESCENDING (most widely demanded first), ties broken on the artifact text.

slices.name: crosswalk
slices.description: Bidirectional KSI to NIST 800-53 control mapping.
slices.ordering: controls ascending by display id; families ascending.

slices.name: families
slices.description: KSI density per control family and theme.
slices.ordering: rows ascending by class letter; families ascending by family code.

slices.name: glossary
slices.description: FRD terms with the KSIs and rules that reference each.

slices.name: indicator-weight
slices.description: KSI indicators ranked by control footprint.
slices.ordering: indicators by control footprint DESCENDING, ties broken on indicator id.

slices.name: readiness
slices.description: Per-class readiness pack: baseline, KSI coverage, artifacts and provider deadlines.
slices.ordering: `classes` ascending by class letter; control lists ascending by canonical id.

slices.name: roles
slices.description: Requirements, deadlines and documents grouped by the party they bind.
slices.ordering: parties by requirement count DESCENDING; requirements within a party ascending by requirement id.

slices.name: search
slices.description: Flat list of every addressable entity, for the global search palette.
slices.ordering: entities grouped by kind, ascending by id within each kind.
